editorialChecks.sourceAttribution: Harari’s forecast is attributed. First person concerns the actual caption question and editorial opinion, not invented experience.
editorialChecks.languages: EN and SQ carry matching source boundaries and examples.
editorialChecks.seoIntent: Harari AI bureaucracy and human control; no keyword volumes invented.
editorialChecks.quantitativeClaims: No unverified timetable, AI adoption rate, job-loss rate or blanket perfect-memory assertion.
editorialChecks.wordLimits: Primary governance summaries are concise across EN and SQ; visual questions are short editorial adaptations. No extensive quotation.
editorialChecks.internalLinks: Existing learning-AI article is present in both languages.
editorialChecks.faq: No generic FAQ or word-count padding.

meaningEvidence: Authorized published-post media retrieved and matched byte-for-byte to the local final Albanian-caption export; ffprobe confirms 103 seconds with English audio.
Reviewed English transcript with previously checked corrections, Albanian SRT and actual video contact sheet. Harari is visible in a ČT24-marked studio.
Source develops the cow/money analogy, contrasts forest and office, and forecasts AI-created bureaucracy beyond human comprehension. These are attributed claims, not measured outcomes.
The actual TikTok caption asks which decision viewers would never leave to AI; that documented question anchors the article.
limitations: The original recording date and complete interview context were not independently matched; publication timestamp is the TikTok sharing timestamp.
Claims about future AI domination or perfect financial memory are not endorsed as facts.
No fabricated personal financial experience, legal entitlement, adoption statistic or job-loss forecast.
